faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device. We never see, store, or transmit your JSON data.

faq.question: What indentation options are available?
faq.answer: You can choose between 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or tab indentation. The formatter also supports minifying JSON to a single line.

faq.question: Can I format large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally in your browser, you can format JSON files as large as your browser's memory allows. There is no file size limit on our side.

faq.question: Does the formatter also validate JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. If your JSON has syntax errors, the formatter will show the exact error message with line and column numbers so you can quickly fix it.

faq.question: What is the difference between JSON formatter and JSON minifier?
faq.answer: A JSON formatter adds indentation and line breaks to make JSON readable and pretty. A JSON minifier removes all whitespace to make JSON as compact as possible. This online JSON formatter supports both — use Format to json beautify your data for readability and Minify for production.

faq.question: Is this a free online JSON prettifier and beautifier?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online JSON formatter, beautifier, and prettifier. You can use it as a json pretty print tool to prettify minified data, make pretty json output, and beautify any JSON string directly in your browser. Format JSON online with no sign-up, no upload — paste and format instantly.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有处理在浏览器中完成，数据不会离开你的设备。我们不会查看、存储或传输你的 JSON 数据。

faq.question: 有哪些缩进选项？
faq.answer: 可以选择 2 个空格、4 个空格或 Tab 缩进。格式化工具还支持将 JSON 压缩为单行。

faq.question: 可以格式化大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。所有处理在浏览器本地完成，只要浏览器内存允许，你可以格式化任意大小的 JSON 文件，我们没有文件大小限制。

faq.question: 格式化工具会验证 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 会。如果你的 JSON 有语法错误，格式化工具会显示精确的错误信息和行列号，方便你快速修复。

faq.question: JSON 格式化和 JSON 压缩有什么区别？
faq.answer: 格式化会添加缩进和换行，让 JSON 更易读。压缩会移除所有空白，让 JSON 尽可能紧凑。这个在线 JSON 格式化工具两种都支持——用格式化提升可读性，用压缩用于生产环境。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的在线json美化工具吗？
